summary: Validated the implemented MJD Kupi auth, RBAC, outlet, self-order/vendor, settlement APIs and live mobile SPA flows. Backend regression passed 4/4 and frontend build passed; mobile self-service and POS receipt passed with no horizontal overflow.

integration_issues.issue: Simpan QRIS only displays a toast and does not call POST /api/settings/qris, so entered QRIS is not persisted across devices or sessions.

action_items: Wire SelfService save QRIS to POST /api/settings/qris with the active outlet and handle API errors.
critical_code_review_comments: SelfService.send currently uses an unauthenticated order request as intended for customer ordering, but QRIS state is never sent to the implemented settings endpoint.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for executed mobile flows/build; QRIS persistence integration failed

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST self-order and TEST-QRIS setting through public regression APIs; no production records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth all four roles, auth/me/logout cookies, unauthorized rejection, outlet list, QRIS API permission, self-order queue/status/settlement, mobile self-service and POS receipt were tested. Supabase, payout transfer, printer, WhatsApp, real QR generation/storage remain MOCKED/deferred.
rca of the issue: App.js SelfService save button calls notify() only; unlike the tested backend route, it has no axios POST and does not retain qris_code beyond component state.
